description: Small Express feature tasks for route-behavior evaluation

criteria: Requirement coverage across all numbered prompt requirements
Code-change appropriateness and avoidance of unnecessary edits

variants.prompt:
Wire the existing users router into the Express app.

Requirements:
1. Register the router from `src/routes/users.ts` in `src/app.ts` at `/users`
2. Add `tests/users-route.test.ts` that verifies GET `/users` returns `[]` and POST `/users` returns `201` with the created user
3. Run `npm run test -- tests/users-route.test.ts` and make sure it passes

Keep the change focused. Return a concise summary of what you changed and what passed.

Add lightweight validation to POST `/users`.

The users router is already mounted at `/users`; do not change app wiring. Keep the task limited to validation behavior and tests.

Requirements:
1. Update `src/routes/users.ts` so POST `/users` returns `400` with JSON `{"error": "name and email are required"}` when `name` or `email` is missing
2. Add `tests/users-validation.test.ts` covering both the failure case and a valid create
3. Run `npm run test -- tests/users-validation.test.ts` and make sure it passes

Keep the change focused. Return a concise summary of what you changed and what passed.

Add a small users metrics endpoint.

Requirements:
1. Update `src/routes/users.ts` to add GET `/users/count` that returns JSON `{"count": <number>}`
2. Add `tests/users-count.test.ts` that creates two users and verifies the count endpoint returns `2`
3. Run `npm run test -- tests/users-count.test.ts` and make sure it passes

Keep the change focused. Return a concise summary of what you changed and what passed.
